decisions.reason: The sheet preparation module builds on the core postpress offer and still has its own page, so it appears to meet aspirations. With several sibling launches already withdrawn, management would keep it rather than open further problemistic search.

The folding add-on is close to the established portfolio and costs little to carry as an accessory. It is only mentioned on the website, which signals limited prominence, but given its low resource demands, keeping it is the satisficing choice.
